scope: Offline metadata and authentic SDK XML contract comparison only; no runtime body analysis or native invocation

comparisonDocumentation.interpretation: The shipped 1.131 XML recommends dynamic Natives, documents original 64-bit x-prefixed identifiers and handle conversion, and still documents a 0..1 RPH ratio. It does not promise a different hash resolver, exact-build support for the candidate hash or a direct-call workaround.

priorDiagnosticProbe.interpretation: The prior diagnostic artifact preserves the published 64-bit literals, expected float/int return types and one IHandleable-derived argument. This excludes source-level integer truncation or an omitted vehicle argument in this artifact; it does not validate runtime marshalling or the native handlers.

compileOnlyContract.interpretation: Both source spellings and the existing getter type-check against each inspected authentic SDK. The libraries contain no plugin or lifecycle entry point and were never executed. Compilation does not establish dispatch equivalence, successful resolution, a corrected provider or live safety.
